messages.subject: Maven + renjin : Could not find artifact org.renjin:renjin-script-engine:jar:0.7.0-RC7 in repo
parts:
I have added reference to renjin in my pom (directly copied from : http://www.renjin.org/#about )

<dependencies>
  <dependency>
    <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
    <artifactId>renjin-script-engine</artifactId>
    <version>0.7.0-RC7</version>
  </dependency>
</dependencies>
<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>bedatadriven</id>
    <name>bedatadriven public repo</name>
    <url>http://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/groups/public/</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>

It does not work, I have the followings : error : 
Could not find artifact org.renjin:renjin-script-engine:jar:0.7.0-RC7 in repo ...


It seems that in this file : 
http://nexus.bedatadriven.com/content/groups/public/archetype-catalog.xml

there is no reference to renjin. Is it normal ?
